function.arguments:
{"path": "llm_papers_plot.py", "content": "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import curve_fit

# LLM paper data
years = np.array([2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025])
papers = np.array([45, 120, 380, 910, 1820, 3650, 9400, 21300, 38700])

# Exponential function for trend line
def exponential_func(x, a, b, c):
    return a * np.exp(b * x) + c

# Fit exponential trend
popt, _ = curve_fit(exponential_func, years, papers, p0=[1, 0.1, 0])
trend_line = exponential_func(years, *popt)

# Create the plot
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 7))

# Plot actual data points
ax.plot(years, papers, 'o-', color='#2E86AB', linewidth=2.5, markersize=10, label='Cumulative Papers')

# Plot exponential trend line
ax.plot(years, trend_line, '--', color='#A23B72', linewidth=2, label='Exponential Trend')

# Key inflection points with annotations
inflection_points = {
    2020: ('GPT-3 Release', 'Mar 2020: 175B parameter model'),
    2022: ('ChatGPT Launch', 'Nov 2022: Consumer AI boom'),
    2023: ('LLM Explosion', '2023: Multi-modal models surge'),
    2024: ('Enterprise Adoption', '2024: Industry integration peak')
}

for year, (title, description) in inflection_points.items():
    idx = np.where(years == year)[0][0]
    ax.annotate(
        title,
        xy=(year, papers[idx]),
        xytext=(year + 0.3, papers[idx] + 2000),
        fontsize=10,
        fontweight='bold',
        color='#F18F01',
        arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#F18F01', lw=1.5),
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.4', facecolor='#FFF5E6', edgecolor='#F18F01', lw=1)
    )
    ax.annotate(
        description,
        xy=(year, papers[idx]),
        xytext=(year + 0.3, papers[idx] + 1500),
        fontsize=8,
        color='#666666',
        style='italic'
    )

# Styling
ax.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_ylabel('Cumulative Published Papers', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_title('Exponential Growth of LLM Research Papers (2017-2025)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)

# Log scale for y-axis to better show exponential growth
ax.set_yscale('log')

# Grid and legend
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
ax.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=10)

# Add growth rate annotation
growth_rate = (papers[-1] / papers[0]) ** (1 / (years[-1] - years[0])) - 1
ax.text(0.02, 0.02, f'~{int(growth_rate*100)}% annual growth', 
        transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=10,
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='#E8F4F8', alpha=0.8))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('llm_papers_growth.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

print("Plot saved as 'llm_papers_growth.png'")"}

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import curve_fit

# LLM paper data
years = np.array([2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025])
papers = np.array([45, 120, 380, 910, 1820, 3650, 9400, 21300, 38700])

# Exponential function for trend line
def exponential_func(x, a, b, c):
    return a * np.exp(b * x) + c

# Fit exponential trend
popt, _ = curve_fit(exponential_func, years, papers, p0=[1, 0.1, 0])
trend_line = exponential_func(years, *popt)

# Create the plot
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 7))

# Plot actual data points
ax.plot(years, papers, 'o-', color='#333333', linewidth=2.5, markersize=10)

# Plot exponential trend line
ax.plot(years, trend_line, '--', color='#666666', linewidth=2)

# Key inflection points with annotations
inflection_points = {
    2020: ('GPT-3 Release', 'Mar 2020: 175B parameter model'),
    2022: ('ChatGPT Launch', 'Nov 2022: Consumer AI boom'),
    2023: ('LLM Explosion', '2023: Multi-modal models surge'),
    2024: ('Enterprise Adoption', '2024: Industry integration peak')
}

# Key inflection points with annotations (right-aligned at specific years)
inflection_years = [2020, 2022]
inflection_labels = {
    2020: 'GPT-3 Release',
    2022: 'ChatGPT Release'
}

for i, year in enumerate(inflection_years):
    idx = np.where(years == year)[0][0]
    # Right-aligned text boxes at different y-positions
    y_texts = [500, 1100]  # GPT-3 at 500, ChatGPT at 1100
    y_text = y_texts[i]
    ax.annotate(
        inflection_labels[year],
        xy=(year, papers[idx]),
        xytext=(year + 0.5, y_text),
        fontsize=10,
        fontweight='bold',
        color='#333333',
        ha='right',
        va='center'
    )
    ax.annotate(
        f'{papers[idx]:,} papers',
        xy=(year, papers[idx]),
        xytext=(year + 0.5, y_text - 150),
        fontsize=8,
        color='#666666',
        ha='right',
        va='center'
    )

# Styling
ax.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_ylabel('Cumulative Published Papers', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_title('Exponential Growth of LLM Research Papers (2017-2025)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)

# Log scale for y-axis to better show exponential growth
ax.set_yscale('log')

# Grid (horizontal only)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', axis='y')



plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('llm_papers_growth.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white', edgecolor='none', pad_inches=0)
plt.show()

print("Plot saved as 'llm_papers_growth.png'")
